summary: Tab and Shift+Tab reveal the focused row of the branch chooser and Tags, and Tab and a click reveal a project hub field 12 px clear of the page's edges, in the first frame that draws the new focus; a pointer press scrolls nothing
limitations: A probe sees only the frames its back-to-back grabs return, so a frame shorter than its recorded resolution may be missed. The remote manager, the tag inspector's Push to... list, macOS, native Wayland and fractional scale factors are not covered natively; at 13 pt the hub page does not scroll at 1000 x 680, so its Tab and click frames show that nothing scrolls

fixture.name: focus-reveal-same-frame
fixture.description: five commits; 30 local branches (main and topic-01 to topic-29, so the branch chooser scrolls) and 30 tags (v1.00 to v1.29, the even ones annotated, so Tags scrolls) spread over them; a local bare origin holding main. the recipe of tab-reveals-branch-and-tag-rows/scenario.json under this task's name, so its objects and refs are the same
